models.py — database mapping¶

Location: module_4/src/models.py. Applicant maps the PostgreSQL applicants table. The module constructs database_url from the five PG* variables, creates an engine with connection health checks, and exposes SessionLocal as its reusable session factory. test_connection() is an application diagnostic, rather than a pytest test; all test code remains in module_4/tests.
